rows.note: Use 可惜 as the all-purpose choice when sadly means unfortunately or regretfully, not to describe a sorrowful manner.

example.english: Sadly, it rained today, so we had to cancel our outdoor concert.
example.traditional: 可惜今日落雨，我哋要取消個戶外音樂會。
example.jyutping: ho2 sik1 gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ceoi2 siu1 go3 wu6 ngoi6 jam1 ngok6 wui2

rows.note: Use 傷心咁 before a verb when someone does something in a sorrowful manner, such as speaking sadly.

example.english: They sadly told me they had to leave.
example.traditional: 佢傷心咁同我講，佢要走喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 soeng1 sam1 gam2 tung4 ngo5 gong2 keoi5 jiu3 zau2 laa3
